snippet.title: The McDonald's Video Game - Flash Game Playthrough
snippet.description:
The McDonald's Video game was a flash game developed by Molleindustria.  Their goal was to make a game that was satirical and absurd in order to show the darker side of how McDonald's was ran.  The game can open your eyes to that new perspective, but it's also really fun to play!

It does a great job of introducing you to the many in real life problems the restaurant causes and how they work in corrupt and unethical ways to fix them.  You can have really great success in the game by tossing safety standards and care for the public out the window.

From the farm, to the slaughterhouse, then the restaurant, and corporate hell, you can control the industry how you want!

On many websites besides Molleindustria, the game had it's name changed to "Burger Tycoon" in order to avoid copyright and other legal issues with McDonald's.  Since there's probably many things in the game they don't like so much.
